description: This file contains test cases for the 'Project' schema in a Perl-based application, utilizing Test2 framework, testing inventory data, caching mechanisms, deletion, and staleness of projects.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the inventory counts for a project with ID 1.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the caching of article units, including cache invalidation and memory cycle checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Test subroutine that deletes all projects and verifies that certain tables are emptied.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the staleness status of projects based on date.
